Turn 1 complete: reconnaissance + governance gate satisfied.

WHAT WAS DONE
1. Comprehensive review. Two deep parallel audits (min_agent core loop; infra/ops) plus my own direct verification of every critical claim against live code and the on-disk 16.9MB journal. 15 defects (D1-D15) confirmed with reproduction evidence, not inference.
2. Reversible safety baseline: git init + .gitignore + commit 4092bc4 (rollback point for the whole refactor). history_version/ (4.5GB) excluded, working tree now 6.1MB.
3. File-backed refactor plan written to docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-28-quantgroup-recovery-and-refactor.md, committed as 36395cd. Satisfies AGENTS.md 1 (文档先行) and the planning-with-files mandatory gate.

KEY VERIFIED FACTS (independent of the subagent reports)
- alpaca-trade-api 3.2.0 REST has NO get_all_positions / get_orders (correct: list_positions / list_orders). Both calls raise AttributeError and are swallowed at data_gateway.py:69-70,86-87. Journal: 851/851 cycles have positions=[] and open_orders=[]. Agent can never sell; no aggregate exposure cap exists.
- reflection.json: trend-follow-sell-001 = 36 cycles, 0 submitted, {HOLD:36}, score 1.0 beats fixed-size-buy-001 (5 real orders, score 0.833). strategy_engine.py:139 is a deterministic argmax on that reward -> self-reinforcing permanent HOLD latch. 800/851 cycles are HOLD.
- heartbeat.json claims RUNNING, pid 2590767, ts 2026-06-23, process dead, 97 days stale. health.py only replays the file; cli.py:61-63 always returns 0. 112/113 reviews are byte-identical {"ok":true}.
- No cron, no systemd unit, no running process, conda not on PATH (~/.bashrc is 1 byte). auto-fix.log and market-check.log are dated TODAY and contain banner+footer but no body, because set -e (not pipefail) + | tee turned 'command not found' into exit 0.
- auto-fix.sh:41-44 raises max_position_value to a hard-coded 5000.0 and :36-39 overrides lifecycle -> direct AGENTS.md §6 violation.
- cli.py:189 injects PolicyEngine, not the LLM. curriculum.py:127-135 silently substitutes a hard-coded _fallback_task and daemon.py:249-262 journals it as SUCCESS. cli.py:238 hard-codes reference_price 100.0 into the prompt; 9 admitted strategies carry 100-200 against SPY ~$735.
- knowledge_library load/list have zero call sites (write-only); 16.9MB journal with no rotation and silent line drops; 9 non-atomic unlocked write sites; no version control (now fixed).

PLAN SHAPE (7 phases, each with a verification gate)
Phase 0 hygiene, Phase 1 runnable+honest (D1/D2/D5/D6), Phase 2 break the latch (D3/D4/D8), Phase 3 close the loop (D11/D12/D13/D14), Phase 4 LLM in the loop with disclosed provenance (D7), Phase 5 working infra (D9/D10/D15), Phase 6 end-to-end proof.

THE ONE SUCCESS CRITERION
submitted>0 AND filled>0 AND non-empty per-strategy PnL attribution AND a lifecycle transition driven by that PnL, read from the journal. Cycle counts and green review files are explicitly NOT accepted as evidence.

BLOCKER TO NOTE (not yet blocking)
ALPACA_API_KEY / ALPACA_SECRET_KEY are absent from the environment and from every .env in the tree. Phase 6 cannot complete without real paper credentials. The Alpaca paper network path is up. Will surface this when Phase 5 makes `doctor` report it.

Then add the regression tests that would have caught each one.

Phases 0 and 1 of the plan are complete and committed. 217 tests passing (was 175).

COMMITTED
- 4092bc4 baseline (rollback point)
- 36395cd the 7-phase refactor plan
- 79967c1 Phase 0 tree hygiene
- a24396b Phase 1 make it runnable and honest

PHASE 0 (79967c1)
history_version/ (4.5GB) moved to /localscratch/liuyime2/_archive_QuantGroup/; deleted screenlog.0 (8.8MB unrelated Codex TUI escape codes), orphan engine.pid/ollama.pid, the engine.log symlink into another tool's scratch dir; restored skill_library/{knowledge,skills}.json from .bak (live files were 3-byte '{}' while 5/6 real entries sat in .bak); deleted the 3 scripts that wrote production strategy files bypassing StrategyAdmission/Guardian with a hard-coded max_position_value=5000.0; deleted dead reasoning_engine.py (contained a fabricated-result factory: _trade/_create_strategy return True, _reconcile returns a fabricated {'matched': True}), reflector.py, modes.py; moved 12 one-offs to tools/legacy/ with a README recording which ones write production state; renamed test_alpaca.py -> tools/alpaca_smoke.py (the test_ prefix made pytest import a network-calling module). Tree 4.5GB -> 5.5MB.

PHASE 1 (a24396b) - verified, not asserted
D1/D2 broker data real or loudly absent: BrokerDataUnavailable; list_positions()/list_orders(); the 'except Exception: return ()' that turned AttributeError into an empty position book for 851 cycles is gone; an unpriceable position now raises instead of vanishing from a risk check. Found and fixed a SECOND latent bug in the same path: Alpaca returns order side lowercase while OpenOrderSnapshot is Literal['BUY','SELL'], so every open order was being dropped by the except - the conflicting-order guard would have stayed inert even after the method-name fix. Stopped fabricating daily_loss = equity - portfolio_value (always 0.0, silently disabling the daily-loss kill switch); AccountSnapshot.day_start_equity_known makes Guardian fail closed. config gained max_total_exposure (default max_position_value*4) and cli.py now PASSES it - it was never wired, so there was no aggregate exposure control at all.
D5 health is liveness: VERIFIED - the 97-day-stale heartbeat that passed 112 consecutive reviews now reports live=false, pid_alive=false, stale=true and --status exits 1 instead of always 0.
D6 clock fails closed: scheduler catches and records last_error; loop journals CYCLE_FAILED and deliberately does NOT synthesise a DataSnapshot (AGENTS.md 2). Previously the gateway call sat outside the try-block, so broker outages were completely invisible.
D8 AGENTS.md 6 restored: auto-fix.sh and auto_reviewer.py no longer assign any risk limit, rewrite lifecycle, or force-enable a strategy. auto-fix.sh is now detect-and-report and correctly reports fixed-size-sell-001 (enabled=true, lifecycle=RETIRED, therefore unselectable) which the old script called 'normal'.
D9 real interpreter and real exit codes: all ops scripts use an absolute CONDA_BIN; set -e -> set -uo pipefail so '| tee' can no longer convert a failure into success; monitor.sh returns its faulty-check count; run_forever.sh detects crash loops (5 restarts under 300s => exit 75) instead of restarting silently forever. VERIFIED - check-market-open.sh now exits 2 on missing credentials (was 0 with an empty body), monitor.sh exits 4 detecting the dead daemon.
Also found and fixed two bugs in my own new code: scheduler.last_error was never cleared on success (caught by my own test), and my run_step/capture helpers used the classic bash 'local rc=$?' bug where local resets $?, so real failures were reported as rc=0.

TESTS 175 -> 217
New test_data_gateway.py asserts the exact REST method names the gateway depends on exist, and that outages raise rather than degrade. New test_governance.py machine-enforces AGENTS.md 6 (no risk-limit assignment, no lifecycle rewrite, no force-enable, no bare 'conda run' from ops scripts) - it immediately caught the bare-conda sites in four scripts. Extended test_health.py, test_scheduler.py, test_loop.py, test_guardian.py.

STILL TRUE AND NOT YET FIXED
The HOLD latch (D3/D4) is untouched: the reward function still pays the maximum score for doing nothing and the selector is still a deterministic argmax on it. 800/851 journal cycles are HOLD. This is the single defect that makes 'self-evolving' structurally impossible and it is the next work unit.
progressNotes.next: Phase 2 - break the HOLD latch. This is the single defect that makes 'self-evolving' structurally impossible: evaluator._score pays the maximum score for doing nothing (verified: trend-follow-sell-001, 36 HOLDs, 0 submitted, score 1.0 beats fixed-size-buy-001 with 5 real orders at 0.833) and strategy_engine.py:139 is a deterministic argmax on it, so the system evolves toward HOLD and locks itself there. Implement: (a) _SYSTEM_REJECTION_REASONS so Guardian's correct rejections stop counting as strategy faults (this is also the root of the retire-then-reenable ping-pong); (b) score = operational x (0.25 + 0.75*exploration) so inaction is never competitive; (c) StrategyResult.trade_attempts; (d) degenerate guard without the kind=='FIXED_SIZE' and lifecycle=='PROBATION' preconditions; (e) the exploration floor so a fresh install probes instead of HOLDing forever. Then the regression test replaying the real reflection.json numbers.

Phases 0-3 complete. 282 tests passing (from 175). Commits: 4092bc4 baseline, 36395cd plan, 79967c1 phase 0, a24396b phase 1, 991c0f2 phase 2, 16dc28c phase 3a, 637b463 phase 3b/3c.

PHASE 2 (991c0f2) - THE LATCH IS BROKEN, PROVEN ON REAL DATA
The reward function paid the maximum score for doing nothing and the selector was a deterministic argmax on it, so the system evolved toward HOLD and locked itself there. 800 of 851 recorded cycles were HOLD. _score is now reliability gated by exploration: operational * (0.25 + 0.75 * trade_attempts/cycles). Inaction is capped at 25% of reliability so it can never be the argmax while any candidate trades - structural, not a special case.

Replayed through the real evaluator on the real 851 journal cycles, then through the real selector on the real strategy library:
    before: trend-follow-sell-001 (36 HOLD, 0 attempts) score 1.000  <- argmax winner
    after:  trend-follow-sell-001 (36 HOLD, 0 attempts) score 0.225
            fixed-size-buy-001    ( 7 attempts)         score 0.900  <- argmax winner
            tiny-fixed-size-001   (15 attempts)         score 0.900

Two real design flaws in my own first attempt, caught by the new tests:
- PnL was additive +/-0.1/0.2 saturating at 1.0, so broker-verified profit could not outrank mere reliability and the PnL signal was discarded at the ceiling. PnL now reserves headroom multiplicatively: no evidence scores score*(1-bonus), verified profit reaches 1.0, verified loss falls below unverified reliability.
- A TREND_FOLLOW spec has no 'action' key so it was eligible as a 'buy' probe even though its direction is implied by price vs reference_price and may be a SELL. Probes now prefer explicit FIXED_SIZE buys and never short.

Also: SYSTEM_REJECTION_REASONS stops Guardian's correct refusals (market closed, daily trade limit) being charged to the strategy - the root of the retire-then-reenable ping-pong that got fixed-size-sell-001 RETIRED for 'severe operational failure rate 1.00' when every order was correctly blocked. A result not carrying the split is read conservatively as 'all rejections are the strategy's fault'. The degenerate guard no longer exempts kind != FIXED_SIZE nor requires lifecycle == PROBATION, and now also catches promoted strategies that stop acting. An exploration floor makes a fresh install probe (smallest explicit FIXED_SIZE buy) instead of HOLDing forever.

Three existing tests were regression locks ON the defect and were inverted rather than worked around: test_lifecycle_manager_promotes_hold_only_trend_after_evidence_cycles asserted a HOLD-only TREND_FOLLOW is PROMOTED; test_evaluator_keeps_per_strategy_metrics_independent asserted a pure-HOLD strategy scores 1.0; a third fixture was named 'after_successful_exposure' while reporting submitted_orders=0.

PHASE 3a (16dc28c) - FILL FEEDBACK, the blocker for the success criterion
Measured on the recorded journal: 23 SUBMITTED orders, 23 with a resolvable client_order_id, 0 with any recorded fill. New FillReconciler polls get_order_by_client_order_id (verified present on alpaca-trade-api 3.2.0), reports fills plus terminal no-fill states, returns nothing on broker outage rather than inventing a fill. The daemon journals ORDER_FILL_CONFIRMED; the evaluator prefers it over the submit response's zero. Fills alone are still not PnL - the evaluator keeps reporting pnl_evidence as missing until closed-lot broker evidence exists, and a test pins that so a fill can never be mistaken for a verified result.

PHASE 3b/3c (637b463) - DURABILITY + KNOWLEDGE READ PATH
New atomicio module (atomic write via tmp+fsync+os.replace, fcntl lock with timeout). All nine write sites now go through it, including the pidfile - a torn pid write can leave '2590' pointing --stop at an unrelated live process. Measured on the real 16.9MB journal: read_all 0.73s -> 0.040s, last_n(50) 0.71s -> 0.045s. Added size-capped rotation, fsync per append, and last_dropped_lines/last_dropped_samples so torn lines are counted rather than vanishing in silence. TradeCounter now uses a targeted streaming scan instead of read_all() every cycle - count_submitted_on(2026-06-18)=10, exactly the max_trades_per_day where the journal shows rejections.

KnowledgeLibrary.load/list had zero call sites, so the library was write-only. PolicyEngine now consults accepted lessons and records them on the decision rationale. Writing that path surfaced a bug in the same commit: it read KnowledgeArtifact.title, which does not exist - the AttributeError fired inside decide_snapshot where TradingLoop's fail-closed handler turns every cycle into HOLD, the exact symptom the change was meant to fix. Pinned by a test.

VERIFIED THIS TURN
--check-env exits 1 naming the missing Alpaca credentials and unreachable ollama. --daemon refuses without credentials rather than crashing.

STILL OPEN
D7: the LLM still makes zero trade decisions. cli.py:189 injects PolicyEngine, so every decision is a static JSON lookup; OllamaDecisionEngine.decide is dead in daemon mode. curriculum._fallback_task still silently substitutes a hard-coded strategy that daemon.py journals as SUCCESS, and the prompt still hard-codes created_at and reference_price 100.0 - the LLM copied that example into 9 admitted strategies against a ~$735 SPY.
D9/D10: no supervisor, no doctor command, and the root docs (LEARNING_STATUS.md, learning_daemon_summary.md, findings.md, progress.md, task_plan.md) still describe the system as running.
Phase 6 needs ALPACA_API_KEY/ALPACA_SECRET_KEY, absent from the environment and from every .env in the tree.
progressNotes.next: Phase 4: put the LLM in the trade decision path with disclosed provenance. Currently cli.py:189 injects PolicyEngine, so every trade decision is a static JSON lookup and OllamaDecisionEngine.decide is dead in daemon mode. Also must remove the hardcoded prompt values at cli.py:232 (created_at 2026-06-10) and :238 (reference_price 100.0) which the LLM copied into 9 admitted strategies against a ~$735 SPY, and make curriculum._fallback_task disclose itself via CurriculumTask.source instead of being journaled as SUCCESS by daemon.py:249-262. Then Phase 5 (doctor + minictrl + systemd + rewrite the root docs that still claim the system is running) and Phase 6 (end-to-end proof, needs Alpaca paper credentials).

All six phases of the plan are complete. 322 tests pass (from 175). 91/91 defect checks pass across all 15 recorded defects. Ollama resolved and both LLM paths verified live against the real model.

COMMITS
4092bc4 baseline (rollback point) / 36395cd the 7-phase plan / 79967c1 phase 0 / a24396b phase 1 / 991c0f2 phase 2 / 16dc28c phase 3a / 637b463 phase 3b/3c / 4831d60 phase 4 / 4c109fb phase 5 / e0ebc65 defect audit / ddc05e4 ollama resolution

WHAT IS PROVEN THIS TURN
Phase 5 delivered the fast-iteration primitive the objective asked for. 'minictrl doctor' checks 20 conditions and exits non-zero on any blocking fault, with a hint for each. It reports:
  [FAIL] alpaca credentials  missing ['api_key', 'secret_key']
  [FAIL] daemon              claims RUNNING but pid_alive=False stale=True age=8387657s
  [PASS] ollama               serving deepseek-r1:8b
  [PASS] proof: submitted>0  23 order(s) submitted
  [WARN] proof: filled>0     0.0 share(s) filled (0 confirmed)
  [WARN] proof: per-strategy pnl empty (pnl_evidence=missing_fill_price_and_broker_activity)
A submission is explicitly not treated as proof.
minictrl gives doctor|once|loop|daemon|install-service|service|logs|status|stop|reconcile|evidence|report|profit|check-env|test|audit, every subcommand propagating its real exit code. tools/min-agent.service.in is a systemd --user unit verified with systemd-analyze, with Restart=always, StartLimitBurst=5 in 900s, and credentials only via EnvironmentFile. STATUS.md and docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-28-min-agent-runbook.md replace five stale root docs that described the system as running while it was 97 days dead.
tools/audit_defects.py re-verifies all 15 defects as source properties; it runs inside the suite and as 'minictrl audit'. Its first draft reported 4 failures that were all artefacts of its own patterns, which I tightened rather than dismissing.
Ollama port/GPU mismatch from ollama.log (:11435, GPU 3) resolved: now serving on 127.0.0.1:11434 with deepseek-r1:8b on GPU 0.
Both LLM paths verified against the real model, not a stub: trade decision 8.4s, valid JSON, decision_source='llm', grounded in the real context; curriculum proposal 2.5s, parsed to a valid CurriculumTask with source='llm'.

WHAT REMAINS - Phase 6, and it is blocked on one input
Phase 6 requires a real paper session proving submitted>0 AND filled>0 AND non-empty broker-derived per-strategy PnL AND a lifecycle transition driven by that PnL. Verified absent: no credential environment variables; .env.optimized contains 25 config keys and zero secrets; the four key names appear only in code, tests and docs, never with a value. The Alpaca paper API IS network-reachable (GET /v2/clock returns HTTP 401, i.e. only the credential is missing), so nothing else stands in the way.

I will not fabricate this. AGENTS.md rule 2 forbids it, and the whole point of this refactor was that a rubber-stamp health story hid a 97-day outage. Calling wait_for_user for the credentials rather than either polling again or declaring victory on a system that has never placed a fill.
progressNotes.next: Phase 6 is the only remaining work and it needs one thing only the operator can supply: Alpaca paper credentials. Everything else in the plan is complete and verified. Once the keys are exported the remaining sequence is mechanical: minictrl doctor (credentials flip to PASS) -> minictrl once -> minictrl loop -> confirm ORDER_FILL_CONFIRMED events appear and per-strategy PnL becomes non-empty -> minictrl install-service && minictrl service enable --now. If credentials cannot be supplied, the objective's '完整全面跑通' requirement cannot honestly be claimed, and the goal should stay active rather than be closed.

stopReason:
Waiting for user input: Phase 6 (the end-to-end proof) is the only remaining work and it needs Alpaca paper credentials, which cannot be obtained or derived by me. Every other phase of the plan is complete and verified: 322 tests pass (from 175), tools/audit_defects.py passes 91/91 checks across all 15 recorded defects, and both LLM paths were verified live against the real deepseek-r1:8b model. The Alpaca paper API is confirmed network-reachable (GET /v2/clock returns HTTP 401), so the credential is the single missing input. I will not fabricate the proof, and I will not declare the objective met while the system has placed zero confirmed fills. Needed: Alpaca **paper** trading credentials, exported in the shell that runs the agent:

    export ALPACA_API_KEY="<your paper key>"
    export ALPACA_SECRET_KEY="<your paper secret>"

(Optionally write them to ~/.config/min-agent/env with chmod 600, which the systemd unit reads via EnvironmentFile — never put them in the unit or in git.)

How to get them: https://app.alpaca.markets — sign up (free), then Paper Trading -> API Keys. No real money is involved; the code rejects any non-paper endpoint in four independent places.

Then the remaining work is mechanical:
    ./minictrl doctor    # the credentials check flips from FAIL to PASS
    ./minictrl once      # one real paper cycle
    ./minictrl loop      # bounded run
    ./minictrl install-service && ./minictrl service enable --now

I will then verify the real success criterion from the journal: submitted>0 AND filled>0 AND non-empty broker-derived per-strategy PnL AND a lifecycle transition driven by that PnL.

Two smaller things worth confirming at the same time, though neither blocks me:
- Whether the market must be open for the paper session. Guardian refuses to place an order when Alpaca reports the market closed, so a full session needs US regular hours (09:30-16:00 ET). If it is currently closed, the run will produce cycles but no orders, and the filled>0 criterion cannot be met until the open.
- Whether you want the existing 851-cycle journal (16.9MB) preserved as history or rotated out. I have left it untouched and gitignored.
